newsitem.title: USA: CompDent unit buying dental facilities.
newsitem.headline: CompDent unit buying dental facilities.

text.p: CompDent Corp. said Tuesday its Dental Health Management Inc. unit has a definitive agreement to acquire 21 dental facilities in Illinois for $15.5 million in cash, less about $1.2 million of debt.

As part of the deal, Dental Health Management has agreed to manage the group dental practice operating in the dental facilities for 40 years. The facilities are currently managed by Workman Management Group, Ltd., based in Effingham, Ill.
CompDent, a dental management company based in Atlanta, said it expects to close the deal early in the third quarter.

The CompDent subsidiary also has an option to acquire nine other dental facilities currently managed by Workman, as well as other dental centres to be opened or acquired by Workman over the next four years in Illinois, Indiana or Missouri.
Dental Health Management, based in Nashville, Tenn., provides dental practice management services to dental practices.
CompDent's stock rose 50 cents to $20.25 on the New York Stock Exchange shortly after midday.
